source: Public-domain melodies for the bass Roadmap, in written pitch in the bass clef (the bass sounds an octave lower; tinyNotation: C = C3, CC = C2, c = C4; b- = B flat), transposed from the pan and voice tunes into first position. Graded tiers file them under List A (lively), B (slow) and C (folk).
